Thursday

🎯 Today’s objective

By the end of this lesson I can...

✓ I can work out the perimeter of any shape, even with missing sides

✓ I can work out the area of a rectangle in m² or cm²

✓ I can work out the area of an L-shape and how many packs to buy

So you can buy the right amount of fence, carpet or paint!

🔑 Perimeter facts

Ask first, then click for each one.

🔁 Perimeter

Perimeter is the ?

distance ALL the way round the edge

➕ How

Add up ?

ALL the sides

▭ Rectangle

Opposite sides are ?

equal: a 9 m by 2 m garden has two 9 m and two 2 m sides

❓ Missing side

Missing side = ?

big side − small side

⬡ Regular shape

Regular means all sides are ?

EQUAL: hexagon 6 sides, octagon 8 sides

Put your finger on a corner and go round. Tick each side as you add it.

🏠 Menu

💡 LED strip lights

You want LED lights all the way round the edge of your gaming desk. The strip is 3 m long.

The desk is 120 cm by 60 cm. Is a 3 m LED strip long enough? (1 m = 100 cm)

🤔 Guess first! Write it down.

Step 1

Add ALL four sides

120 + 60 + 120 + 60 = 360 cm

Step 2

cm to m: divide by 100

360 cm = 3.6 m

Step 3

Compare with the strip

3.6 m is more than 3 m

NO! You are 60 cm short 😬

🛏️ L-shaped bedroom

Look at the picture. Chat first, then click.

EASY

🏠 Menu

🔑 Area facts

Ask first, then click for each one.

🟦 Area

Area is the ?

SPACE inside a shape

🔲 Count

1 square on a 1 cm grid = ?

1 cm² (one square centimetre)

✖️ Rectangle

Area = ?

length × width

📐 Units

6 m × 2 m = 12 ?

12 m² (square metres)

⚠️ Not the same

Perimeter goes ROUND, area ?

fills the INSIDE

Area always has SQUARE units: cm² or m².

🏠 Menu

🍕 Square pizza deal

Square pizzas are everywhere right now. Which deal gives you MORE pizza?

Deal A: one 30 cm square pizza. Deal B: two 20 cm square pizzas. Which is more pizza?

🤔 Guess first! Write it down.

Step 1

Deal A: length × width

30 × 30 = 900 cm²

Step 2

Deal B: two pizzas

2 × 20 × 20 = 800 cm²

Step 3

Compare

900 cm² is more than 800 cm²

Deal A: 100 cm² MORE pizza 🍕
